{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=14|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
*****[[Iran]]ian [[President of Iran|president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] tells [[France|French]] [[President of France|president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] that the [[Islamabad Talks]] did not lead to a deal because the [[United States]] took "maximalist positions" and had a "lack of goodwill". [https://aje.news/8xcc64?update=4490877 (Al Jazeera)] 
*****[[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani prime minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] says that he will visit fellow mediators in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]], and [[Ankara]], [[Turkey]], to push for a second round of talks between Iran and the U.S. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/14/pakistan-pm-headed-to-saudi-and-turkiye-amid-prospect-of-new-us-iran-talks (Al Jazeera)]
*****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] reportedly tells the ''[[New York Post]]'' that a second round of talks between Iran and the U.S. could occur within the next two days. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/14/trump-iran-war-strait-of-hormuz-negotiations.html (CNBC)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****At least three [[oil tanker]]s pass through [[Strait of Hormuz|the strait]], including the [[Panama]]-flagged ''Peace Gulf'', which took the new route through Iranian waters as instructed by the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]]. [https://aje.news/8xcc64?update=4491347 (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Saudi Arabia]] asks the U.S. to end its [[Naval blockade of Iran|naval blockade]] of the strait. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/saudi-arabia-pushes-us-to-remove-its-blockade-in-strait-of-hormuz-report/3904886 (AA)]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks]]
****[[Israel]]i and [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] officials meet in [[Washington, D.C.]], U.S., for the first direct [[peace talks]] between the countries in decades, with Israel prioritizing [[Hezbollah]]'s disarmament and Lebanon limiting its mandate to [[ceasefire]] discussions. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/rubio-hosts-israeli-lebanese-envoys-for-first-direct-talks-in-decades/articleshow/130263637.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]
****At the Washington meeting, Israeli and Lebanese officials agree to begin direct negotiations in the future. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israel-lebanon-agree-to-begin-direct-talks-us-says-following-meeting-in-washington/3905716 (AA)]
***Three people are killed by an Israeli raid in [[Adloun]], [[Sidon District]], Lebanon. [https://aje.news/8xcc64?update=4490760 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Palestinian tunnel warfare in the Gaza Strip]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] announces that troops from the 205th Brigade and [[Yahalom (IDF)|Yahalom]] have destroyed four [[Hamas]] tunnels over the weekend. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-893005 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***Four people, including a three-year-old, are killed and nine others injured in an Israeli [[airstrike]] on a [[Palestinian Civil Police Force (Hamas)|police]] vehicle in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-hits-police-car-gaza-killing-four-medics-say-2026-04-14/ (Reuters)]
***Two people, including a 14-year-old, are killed by Israeli gunfire in [[North Gaza Governorate]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-hits-police-car-gaza-killing-four-medics-say-2026-04-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***[[Médecins Sans Frontières]] reports that two people are killed and 56 injured following five drone strikes by the [[Sudanese Armed Forces|Sudanese military]] in [[West Darfur]] and [[Central Darfur]], [[Sudan]]. [https://reliefweb.int/report/sudan/msf-sudan-flash-quote-drone-attacks-darfur (ReliefWeb)]
**[[United Nations]] [[Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator]] [[Tom Fletcher (diplomat)|Tom Fletcher]] reports that around 700 people have been killed in drone strikes in [[Sudan]] since the year started as the conflict enters its fourth year. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/nearly-700-civilians-reported-killed-in-drone-strikes-since-january-amid-sudans-civil-war-un?ref=latest (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[War on drugs]]
**[[Operation Southern Spear]], [[United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear]]
***Four people are killed in an [[airstrike]] carried out by the [[United States Navy]] against an alleged drug boat in the [[Pacific Ocean|eastern Pacific]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/15/us-forces-kill-4-people-in-latest-strike-on-vessels-in-eastern-pacific (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Anglophone Crisis]], [[List of pastoral visits of Pope Leo XIV|Pastoral visits of Pope Leo XIV]]
**[[Ambazonia]]n [[List of Ambazonian militant groups|militant groups]] announce a temporary ceasefire in [[Cameroon]] after nearly a decade of conflict in anticipation of [[Pope Leo XIV]]'s visit on April 15. [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/world/news/2026-04/cameroon-anglophone-separatists-cessation-hostilities-pope-visit.html (Vatican News)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**Eleven kidnapping victims, including two [[National Drug Law Enforcement Agency|NDLEA]] personnel, are rescued and several suspected bandits are arrested by the [[Nigerian Army]] in [[Raid (military)|raids]] across [[Nigeria]]. [https://punchng.com/army-rescues-11-kidnap-victims-arrests-suspected-terrorist/ (''The Punch'')]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**Four people are killed and at least 25 others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone attack]] in [[Dnipro]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/0414/1568097-ukraine-russia/ (RTÉ)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**In a joint operation with international ​support, [[Somali armed forces|Somali military]] and [[Jubaland Dervish Force|Jubaland regional forces]] kill at least 27 [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] militants in the [[Autonomy|semi-autonomous]] state of [[Jubaland]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/somalia-says-it-killed-27-al-shabaab-militants-operation-with-international-2026-04-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*English artists [[Billy Idol]], [[Iron Maiden]], [[Joy Division]] / [[New Order (band)|New Order]], [[Oasis (band)|Oasis]], [[Phil Collins]], and [[Sade (band)|Sade]], and American artists [[Luther Vandross]] and [[Wu-Tang Clan]], are announced as the 2026 inductees of the [[Rock and Roll Hall of Fame]] in [[Cleveland]], [[Ohio]], U.S., in the performers category. [https://www.theguardian.com/music/2026/apr/14/rock-and-roll-hall-of-fame-class-of-2026-inductees (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]]
***[[Price of oil|Oil prices]] decline, with [[West Texas Intermediate]] for May delivery falling 6.2% to [[United States dollar|US$]]92.94 per barrel and [[Brent Crude]] decreasing 3.77% to $95.61, amid expectations of reduced tensions in the Middle East. [https://www.nampa.org/text/22909537 (AFP via NAMPA)]
***The [[Ministry of Energy (Pakistan)|Pakistani energy ministry]] announces daily [[power outage]]s of about two hours during evening peak demand periods throughout the country, except in [[Hyderabad, Pakistan|Hyderabad]] and [[Karachi]], to reduce [[Petroleum industry in Pakistan|fuel]] costs and limit [[tariff]] increases amid higher energy prices linked to [[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis|disruptions]] in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/pakistan-power-cuts-energy-prices-iran-war-6058211 (AFP via CNA)]
**American stocks, including the [[S&P 500]], [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]], and [[Nasdaq Composite]], rise amidst the possibility of renewed Iran–U.S. talks. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/13/stock-markets-today-live-updates.html (CNBC)]
**Stocks in the [[United Kingdom]] increase amidst hopes of new Iran–U.S. talks. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/london-stocks-rebound-hopes-us-iran-talks-lift-sentiment-2026-04-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 20 people are killed and 36 others are severely burnt in an explosion at a privately-owned [[power station]] in [[Sakti district]], [[Chhattisgarh]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/operational-failure-led-to-chhattisgarhs-vedanta-boiler-blast-that-killed-20-11368683 (''NDTV'')]
*Twelve people are killed and hundreds of homes are damaged after heavy rains across [[Haiti]]. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-flooding-northwest-destroyed-rains-b45d5a45943ba4fc16c48261e96b8b18 (AP)]
*Eleven people are killed and another is injured when a van collides with a cement mixer in [[Thane district]], [[Maharashtra]], India. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/11-killed-in-cement-mixer-car-crash-on-kalyan-murbad-road-in-maharashtra-thane-mumbai-101776074776703.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Climate change in Japan]]
**[[Japan]] records its lowest-ever net [[greenhouse gas emissions]] in fiscal year 2024, falling 1.9% to 994 million tonnes due to reduced [[Energy in Japan|energy use]] and increased reliance on [[Nuclear power in Japan|nuclear]] and [[renewable energy]] sources. [https://www.dailysabah.com/life/environment/japan-reports-record-low-greenhouse-gas-emissions (AFP via ''Daily Sabah'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]], [[Israel–Italy relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Italy|Italian prime minister]] [[Giorgia Meloni]] announces that [[Italy]] is suspending the automatic renewal of an  agreement with [[Israel]] on exchanging military equipment and technology "in view of the current situation." [https://aje.news/8xcc64?update=4490954 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Norway–Ukraine relations]]
**The [[Støre cabinet|Norwegian government]] announces that [[Ukraine]] will produce [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] in [[Norway|the country]] as part of a bilateral defence cooperation agreement. Norway will support the production of Ukrainian drones, while Ukraine will share data, information and knowledge of the technology with Norway. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-produce-drones-norway-oslo-says-2026-04-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Chinese property sector crisis (2020–present)]]
**The founder of the property development company [[Evergrande]] [[Hui Ka Yan]] pleads guilty to several charges, including fundraising fraud and illegally taking public deposits, at a trial in [[Shenzhen]], [[Guangdong]], [[China]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-04-14/evergrande-founder-pleads-guilty-to-fraud/106564948 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[2026 Siverek school shooting]]
**A 19-year-old man [[Mass shooting|opens fire]] [[school shooting|at a school]] in [[Siverek]], [[Şanlıurfa Province]], [[Turkey]], wounding 16 people, before killing himself. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/14/europe/turkey-school-shooting-intl (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Irish fuel protests]]
**In the [[Republic of Ireland]], the [[Government of the 34th Dáil]] wins a [[no confidence]] vote tabled by [[Sinn Féin]] over its handling of recent fuel protests. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czd773zjypgo (BBC News)]
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]], [[Controversies of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
**The [[Somalia|Somali]] [[Federal Government of Somalia|federal government]] fails to ensure the timely succession of the [[Federal Parliament of Somalia|Federal Parliament]], as its term expired on 14 April. The lapse creates significant uncertainty, with no clear plan for [[2026 Somali parliamentary election|forthcoming elections]] following a series of [[Constitutional crisis in Somalia|constitutional crises]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-14/somalia-parliament-s-mandate-expires-without-elections-in-sight?utm_source=website&utm_medium=share&utm_campaign=copy (Bloomberg)] [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-parliament-mandate-expires-as-president-faces-30-day-countdown (Garowe Online)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2026/Apr/204913/somalias_federal_parliament_term_expires_amid_electoral_dispute.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*Greenland's former [[Prime Minister of Greenland|prime minister]] [[Múte Bourup Egede]] is appointed as the new [[Ministry of foreign affairs|foreign minister]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/greenland-appoints-former-pm-egede-foreign-minister-2026-04-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Papua New Guinea|Papuan]] [[Papua New Guinea Defence Force|soldiers]] block several roads across [[Port Moresby]], protesting the military's recent recruitment controversies. [https://www.nbc.com.pg/post/34603/soldiers-block-off-murray-barracks (NBC PNG)]
